svg.title: University-1652: Street → satellite: coverage-constrained success
svg.desc: Three separate seeds, four stored coverage observations per variant. Success means selected AND correct over full common N. Equal selected counts do not imply equal membership. No added origin, inference or pooling.
svg.text: Coverage-constrained success on the full query set
Selected AND Top-1 correct / full query N (%)
Success uses all N queries as denominator, not accuracy among the selected k.
Variants select their own queries by margin; equal k does not mean equal members.
Overlap counts shared selected members, not shared correct predictions.
Four saved coverage points only; connecting lines guide the eye. No added origin.
Higher coverage admits more queries; rising success need not mean better ranking.
Seeds/tasks stay separate. No pooled statistics, SD, CI, bootstrap or p-values shown.
